title: Minimum trees on a lot over 1,000 m2: as 700 to 1,000 m2 plus 1 medium per 400 m2 or part over 1,000 m2 (Table 1.2a)
text: Tree Canopy. C1.2.4 A minimum number of trees to be planted in accordance with Tables 1.2a and provided with the required deep soil area per tree in accordance with Table 1.2b. Table 1.2a Minimum tree provisions. Lot size greater than 1,000m2: 2 medium trees or 1 large tree and 1 small tree PLUS 1 medium tree per 400m2 in excess of 1,000m2 or part thereof.

replaces.note: R10-R25: 2/3/4 trees on 2 m x 2 m pits -> sized trees with deep soil

notes: from: ch3 C1.2.4. diverges: lot-size tree table (p10) as C1.2.4. Lot over 1,000 m2 (rule condition). Extra medium trees = ceil((area - 1000) / 400), tested as 400 x extra >= area - 1000: either 2 + extra medium trees, or 1 large and 1 small plus the extra medium trees. Counts are the trees planted across the development lot by Table 1.2b size, excluding the C1.2.5 parking shade trees; a retained significant tree counts like-for-like by its size (C1.2.6 note). The table does not say whether a larger tree may stand in for a smaller one, so it is tested literally (verify). For R10-R25 apartments this is a step up from Part B (C4P1-011).

verified.note: Table 1.2a (p10) does not say whether a larger tree may stand in for a smaller one (e.g. a large tree for a required medium tree); counts tested literally.
